requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用两个按钮控制 D13 LED，其中 D2 按钮用于开灯，D3 按钮用于关灯。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_0 pressed rising (io_0 becomes true) while io_1 remains false; then hold and release
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 becomes true when io_0 is pressed and io_1 remains false; io_2 returns to false after io_0 is released (io_1 still false)

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用两个按钮控制 D13 LED，其中 D2 按钮用于开灯，D3 按钮用于关灯。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Start with io_0 pressed (io_0 true) and io_1 false; then press io_1 (io_1 becomes true) while io_0 remains false; then hold and release
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 becomes false when io_1 is pressed; io_2 remains false until a subsequent D2 press makes io_0 true again while io_1 is false

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用两个按钮控制 D13 LED，其中 D2 按钮用于开灯，D3 按钮用于关灯。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Simultaneous press: in one control step both io_0 and io_1 become true; then keep both true for one step and release
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: In the simultaneous-press step, io_2 is false (D3 off dominates when io_1 is true)
